payment.secure: You will be redirected to the secure payment page of our provider Stripe (3D Secure authentication). The cinema does not store any card data.

confirmation.title: Thank you for your booking
confirmation.text: Your payment has been sent. Your booking will be confirmed once Stripe validates it and your ticket will be emailed to you.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Le Grand Cinéma (Mende) is responsible for the data collected when you book online.

data.title: Data collected
data.text: Name, email address, postcode or country, booked seats and fares. No card data: payment is handled by our provider Stripe.

purposes.title: Purposes
purposes.text: Managing your booking, sending you your ticket and producing anonymous attendance statistics (where spectators come from, especially during the festival).

legal.title: Legal basis
legal.text: Performance of the ticket sale contract.

retention.title: Retention period
retention.text: Your details are kept for 3 years after the screening, then deleted. Statistics cannot identify you.

recipients.title: Recipients and hosting
recipients.text: Authorised cinema staff and Stripe for payment. Data is hosted in France (Microsoft Azure, France Central region).

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can ask to access, correct or delete your data by writing to dpo@legrandcinema.test. You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (cnil.fr).
